Prior review retained below:
Reviewed all 240 rationales against exact question wording, agreement direction, source scope and counterevidence in a distinct pass after initial assessment. Confirmed Støre Labour minority and 11 September 2026 cabinet change, implemented May 2026 Ukrainian protection restriction, October 2026 AI agreement, current KRLE version and March 2026 GMO trial. Primary evidence was crosschecked with Associated Press, Freedom House and VG, plus WTO and other specialist institutional evidence; these publishers were not counted as separate merely because government departments differ. Added specific seatbelt and cultural-diet evidence, strengthened adoption support and replaced generic gradualism with the Article 121 constitutional process. Removed secular-religious-11 because heraldic Christian history is insufficient to prove present endorsement on government buildings. Nine unresolved questions remain: secular-religious-11; innovation-caution-07,08,11; culture-nature-02,05,06,10,13. All remain null/unknown with specific research limitations. Review attention for the independent parent: authority-liberty-14 extrapolates conditional employee whistleblowing to public disclosure; immigration-14 reflects EEA regional preference, not cultural compatibility testing; public-private-10 distinguishes municipally owned from merely managed rental stock; innovation-05 infers acceptance of job transition without a numerical mass-displacement pledge; innovation-09 infers a technology preference from implemented industrial decarbonisation rather than a universal consumption ranking. Culture-nature-03 generalises documented education/role mechanisms moderately; 04/09/11 are explicit interactionist inferences from health guidance, not equal causal shares; 12 distinguishes innate temperament from learned handling; 14 uses the incumbent government causal account, not merely funded research, but immigrant origin is not race. Culture-nature 07/08/15 rely on adopted social-competence guidance explicitly stating primarily everyday interaction, not programme existence. No national IQ claim was inferred from individual heritability, and no ethical curriculum was used to fill immediate moral intuitions. Flag File page, creator and PD-shape status verified, Commons PNG downloaded and visually checked without cropping. Shared footer credits, archive, generation and browser integration remain parent responsibilities. Final profiles validate country norway returned only the nine unresolved answers (18 paired error messages), with no other errors, no warnings and no neighbours. Because answers are unresolved, no completed similarity comparison or publishable scores are claimed. No independent second-agent audit or publication is claimed. Separate completion review: challenged all new estimates against the exact wording and earlier gap reasons. Assumptions remain contextual extrapolations, not verified implemented rules or causal rankings. Specific restrictions: nonsuspect records versus document schedules; public dress versus school accommodations; healthy implanted enhancement versus therapeutic/noninvasive products; interests versus career choices; individual heredity versus national/racial causes; immediate intuition versus reflective education. Neither a modifiable trait nor a funded study proves predominance or adoption. Mixed responses reflect an affirmative interaction or conditional-policy interpretation rather than uncertainty alone. New assumption IDs: secular-religious-11, innovation-caution-07, innovation-caution-08, innovation-caution-11, culture-nature-02, culture-nature-05, culture-nature-06, culture-nature-10, culture-nature-13. Prior complete same-agent assessment review is retained; this continuation does not claim a fresh independent 240-source reread or human sign-off. Shared credits and validation are recorded in the completion report. Completion validator warnings were read individually: neutral choices reflect mixed ownership, service-specific contracting, staged/graded regulation, family-law distinctions or explicit development interaction. No neighbour reached 95% in the saved pre-archive diagnostics; archive revalidates against added peers.
